lines.en: My five fingers crawl one after another.
I drift forward through the air.
My wrist is severed, yet I still move.

lines.zh: 我跳过扫帚柄，又落回墙上。
lines.en: I hop over the broom handle and settle back onto the wall.
I go around the broom and keep moving.
My fingers tap-tap against the floor.
I float up beside your head.

lines.zh: 我拐弯的时候整个翻过来。
lines.en: I flip over entirely when I turn.
Wind fills the cloth of me.
I advance by stretching and contracting.
I slip along the base of the wall.
Palm down, I creep along.
I hover with my fingers slightly curled.
I open my palm and close it.
The index finger moves first; the rest follow.
I am waiting for you to play.
Fine embroidery runs over my cloth.

lines.zh: 我掌心朝上，等不到人猜拳。
lines.en: Palm up, I wait for someone to play rock paper scissors.
I live without an arm.

lines.zh: 扫帚靠在墙角，我看了看。
lines.en: The broom leans in the corner; I glance at it.
My fingers uncurl one by one.
I squeeze the empty air once.
A loose thread drifts from my cuff.
I am as quiet as a piece of cloth.
I listen for someone entering the hut.

lines.zh: 我抖动了一下，像在呼吸。
lines.en: I twitch once, as if breathing.
This hand stays raised.
My fingertips point at the door.
Rock, paper, scissors — care for a round?
I always throw paper.
If you win, I go with you.

lines.zh: 你的手势太复杂，我猜不透。
lines.en: Your gestures are too complex for me to read.
I used to sweep the floor.
I have been in this hut a long while.

lines.zh: 你带来的空白木偶，我认得。
lines.en: I recognize the blank puppet you brought.
A blank puppet? You brought one?
I can only strike; nothing more.
Do not stuff me up a sleeve.

lines.zh: 我张开五指，跟你打招呼。
lines.en: I spread five fingers in greeting.

lines.zh: 你握拳，我猜你要出石头。
lines.en: You clenched your fist; I guess rock.
I will not stray; I am floating.
Your fingers moved. No cheating.
I am only a glove. Nothing to fear.

lines.zh: 你看我很久了，想好了吗？
lines.en: You have looked long enough. Decided?
The witch left, and only I remained.

lines.zh: 我掌心朝上，等你的答案。
lines.en: Palm up, I wait for your answer.
A tear opens in my cloth.
My fingers have gone stiff.
I drift a little off balance.

lines.zh: 我不会疼，只是缩了一下。
lines.en: I feel no pain; I only flinch.
Two threads snapped.
I clench tight, then slowly open.
I retreat to the wall and sink lower.
My palm is scuffed.
I only stayed because I won the game.
This cloth body is thin.
Cloth does not eat.
Are you going to put me on?
This will not fit my fingers.
Up close, I still cannot smell it.
I take it; it is very light.
This could serve as a rag.

lines.zh: 你举得这么高，我够不到。
lines.en: You hold it high; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 木偶不用喂，你自己留着。
lines.en: The puppet needs no feeding. Keep it.
My index finger hooks once — accepted.
Put me on and the work goes easier.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我就翻过去了。
lines.en: You bump me and I flip over.
Cloth is soft; there is no sound.
My fingers catch on your hem.
I drift aside to clear the way.
Such a light touch I will not remember.
You stepped on my cuff.
I spin once and steady myself.

lines.zh: 木头和布，撞起来没意思。
lines.en: Wood and cloth make a dull collision.
Back off a little; I want to stretch.

lines.zh: 我的指尖碰到你的手臂。
lines.en: My fingertips brush your arm.
You throw rock, I throw paper. I win.
Another round. Do not give up yet.
Let us work in step.
You draw it in; I strike.

lines.zh: 我只要一个出手的角度。
lines.en: I need only the right angle to strike.
I cannot fight long. Remember that.

lines.zh: 手指打结了，帮我理一下。
lines.en: My fingers knotted. Help me untangle them.
You count as my companion now.
Let us go together; do not leave me.
Palm up, I wait for your hand.

lines.zh: 我拿指腹推着它，滚进袖口。
lines.en: I push it with my fingertips until it rolls into my cuff.
A glove cannot grip things well.
I cradle it on my whole palm.
If it drops, I cannot pick it back up.
I wedge it between my fingers.
It is slippery; it took two tries.
The glove lifts it up for you to see.
I can tuck a little into my cuff.
I picked it up, gently.
Do not rush me; I have only one hand.
That thing — I will slap it.
My palm has opened toward it.

lines.zh: 我飘到它够不到的高度。
lines.en: I float above its reach.
I will sweep at its feet.
It does not notice the cloth moving.
Let me try one strike.
I have it; this will be quick.
I go along the wall.
It turns, and I am gone again.

lines.zh: 这个我不怕，只是一块布。
lines.en: I am not afraid — I am only cloth.
Three steps from it.
When it raises a hand, I strike.
I drift slowly around it.
It swung once and missed.
Flat to the ground, it cannot see me.
I wait for the back of its neck.
The wind stirs my cuff.

lines.zh: 它每一次呼吸，我都记着。
lines.en: I mark every breath it takes.
It has started looking for me.
I have settled on its shoulder.
It does not feel the cloth.
One more second. Just one.
My hand is already open.
It is near the wall and cannot retreat.
The angle is right; I strike.
One slap across it.
My fingers jab its eye.
Even cloth can hurt.
I swat once and pull back.
It missed; I press in.
That one landed loudly.
My fingertips are numb.
I have caught its wrist.
It cannot shake me off.
I let go and slap again.
I rise from the corner of the room.
You won the game, so here I am.
The broom still leans by the door.
The cloth shakes, and I am alive.
I slide down from the shelf.
This hut is very old.
First I stretch my five fingers.
I drift into the light.

lines.zh: 女巫的东西都还在原处。
lines.en: The witch's things are all still in place.
Palm up, I wait for you.
Dust settles on me.
The door was open, so I came out.
I shake out my cuff.
This hand follows you now.
Flame licks at my cuff.

lines.zh: 我飘不稳，直直落到地上。
lines.en: I lose my lift and drop straight down.

lines.zh: 湿透的布沉得抬不起来。
lines.en: Soaked cloth is too heavy to lift.
The blast curls my cloth inside out.
Something like a needle pierces my cloth.

lines.zh: 有股力量在扯我的手指。
lines.en: A force tugs at my fingers.
I drift lower and lower.

lines.zh: 雷光过处，我的布边焦了。
lines.en: Lightning scorched the edge of my cloth.
I fall with no edge to catch.
